title: Sunset-Bridge: Staged Migration Runway and Cross-Functional GTM for Model-Tag Retirement
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Coordinate a staged retirement of legacy model tags and provide a 'sunset-bridge' migration experience: compatibility shims, self-serve migration dashboard, SDK compat helpers, and a deliberate communications schedule so customers migrate with minimal regression risk.
acceptance_criteria: Self-serve migration dashboard live in Console that shows customers: affected routes, estimated token impact, recommended target tags
Compatibility shim deployed that maps legacy tags to compatible model variants with opt-out flag
SDK patch released that surfaces deprecation warnings and automatic aliasing for 3 major languages
Comms cadence executed (pre-notice, migration window, final sunset) and release notes published with migration guide links
No more than 3% increase in latency on Hosted API during staged cutover windows as measured by Console SLO dashboard
tasks: PM: finalize migration policy and gating criteria (canary thresholds, fallback rules)
Eng: implement compatibility shim service (tag aliasing + runtime fallback) and automated feature flag
Eng: add metrics and tracing hooks for shim usage and error rates
DX/Docs: author migration guide, sample client patches, and release notes templates
SDK: add deprecation warning and opt-out environment variable in python/js/go SDKs
Console: build migration dashboard mockups and telemetry surfaces
Support: prepare canned responses and playbook for support reps
Legal/Security: review any data retention/KMS implications for customers during migration
GTM: prepare customer segmentation list and outreach sequences

2026-03-22: SDK PRs merged with deprecation warnings
2026-04-05: Beta: compatibility shim enabled for 10% of traffic (internal + opt-in customers)
2026-04-19: Console migration dashboard beta release and feedback loop
2026-04-26: Public pre-notice comms to customers and partner integrators
2026-07-01: Final sunset of legacy model tags (automated alias removed unless opt-out requested)
stakeholders: Engineering: Mei Chen (runtime), Jorge Alvarez (backend shim), Priya Rao (SDK)
comms_plan: Pre-notice (2 weeks before migration window): high-level blog + console banner explaining intent and timeline
Targeted outreach (1 week before): segmented email to heavy users of legacy tags with migration suggestions and estimated effort
Migration window start: release notes, migration dashboard link, SDK release notes, GitHub sample scripts
Ongoing: weekly status updates on Console, public changelog with known issues and roll-forward guidance
Final sunset notice (48 hours before): clear instructions to pin to a supported variant or contact support to request a prolonged alias
migration_guide_outline: Overview: Why tags are changing and risk model
Compatibility matrix: legacy tag -> recommended target variants with cost/latency tradeoffs
Quickstart: 5-minute migration using SDK aliasing or query param
Edge cases: long conversations, KV cache invalidation, streaming vs non-streaming behaviors
Rollback and validation: test prompts and perf checks to validate parity
Support: how to file a migration assistance ticket and SLA expectations
implementation_notes: Compatibility shim will act as a runtime mapping layer and attempt lightweight normalization of call-level arguments before routing
Fallback semantics: primary route to recommended variant; on degraded health, fallback to next-compatible variant and emit telemetry
We will expose 'sunset_bridge' feature flag per-tenant so Dedicated/Private customers can opt into different timing
KV cache keys must include model-tag namespace to avoid cross-variant poisoning; engineering will add a migration job to rebuild hot caches for large customers
SDKs should add a non-fatal deprecation warning (warn once per process) and an opt-out via REDWOOD_SUNSET_BRIDGE=disable
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Unexpected quality regressions after aliasing -> Mitigation: staged canaries + A/B holdback and rollback policy
Risk: Increased latency due to shim routing -> Mitigation: benchmark shim performance, hotpath in C++ runtime if needed
Risk: Confused customers -> Mitigation: clear migration dashboard, in-console help, and proactive reach-outs to high-usage accounts
Risk: KV cache inconsistency -> Mitigation: add cache key namespace and migration job; monitor cache hit rates post-cutover
observability_and_metrics: Metric: number of requests using legacy tags per day
Metric: latency delta 95p pre/post mapping (goal <10ms regression)
Dashboard: per-tenant migration progress, top failing prompts, and rollback triggers
Alert: >1% error rate on mapped requests or >20% spike in tail latency triggers automatic rollback of mapping for that cohort
